New bat changes as demonstrated during the Ground Truth Test. These include 1) changing the curve fitting model around impact,; 2) enabling the software to classify a swing as either a Hit or a Miss and apply either a two-curve or one-curve approach; 3) an updated bat keypoints model. Changes to allow Post Process to do both the new method and old method of bat tracking. Fix bug where some Post Process Release tasks calculated the wrong release point
